descriptor.name: Burkina Faso DGI eCadastre public cadastral map GeoJSON
descriptor.operator: Direction générale des Impôts du Burkina Faso (DGI)
descriptor.attribution: Direction générale des Impôts du Burkina Faso — eCadastre
descriptor.licenceNote: Public anonymous map access observed. Explicit redistribution/reuse permission and required attribution terms remain unverified.
descriptor.scope: Native-ID parcel availability in four declared Bobo-Dioulasso diagnostic windows only. Three distributed west/east/south reads support spatial spread; they and the near-WUP window are not a municipal boundary, coverage manifest, or citywide-completeness proof.
descriptor.identityPolicy: Native feature.id must equal properties.FID; canonical BF-ECADASTRE:<native-id>. Exact reads independently scan the declared lookup windows and return only requested full polygons. No process-local cache, geometry-derived ID or false absent-ID claim.

sourceClassification.basis: First-party DGI links its eCadastre service; the current cadastral viewer marks geometry as PLOT, and public responses supply native FID parcel MultiPolygons in separated Bobo urban windows. No sale listing, proposal or planning-overlay endpoint is used.

followUps: Scope is limited to the declared diagnostic windows; no citywide completeness or municipal boundary is established.
Provider appears capped at 1000 features, ignores tested paging, and supplies no total/truncation metadata. Area reads stay incomplete and missing exact IDs unresolved.
DONE/OK meanings and current/historic semantics remain undocumented; these fields are not retained or used to filter parcels.

Native storage CRS, native wire axes, datum/operation/grid proof and external survey alignment require second-pass investigation. Output GeoJSON declares EPSG:4326 with observed longitude/latitude coordinates.
Metric EPSG:32630 is used only for independent bounded quality measurements; no returned source geometry is changed.
Explicit DGI reuse/redistribution permission and mandated attribution are unverified. Technical qualification does not enable runtime or imply rights.
The hypothetical app city key is a proposed future binding only; no city configuration or catalog is changed.
